worst_places.after: Настраивается пул не в `schema.prisma`, а параметрами в самой строке подключения: `?connection_limit=20&pool_timeout=10`. `connection_limit` — максимум соединений в пуле (по умолчанию `min(10, max_connections / 2)`). `pool_timeout` — сколько секунд ждать свободное соединение, прежде чем бросить ошибку (по умолчанию 10).

worst_places.after:
Различие в том, откуда берётся схема. Prisma — schema-first: вы пишете `schema.prisma`, а клиент генерируется из неё. TypeORM — code-first: вы пишете классы с декораторами, а таблицы выводятся из них.

**Сильные стороны Prisma:** клиент генерируется автоматически и полностью типизирован, миграции diff-ятся сами, удобная разработка (DX, developer experience). **Слабые:** меньше контроля над итоговым SQL, динамические запросы строить неудобно.

patterns: THE DOMINANT PATTERN — the bank is 14 topics wearing 40 hats, and the thin copy contradicts the good one. Every subject appears 2-4 times: schema (q-1/21), CRUD (q-2/22/25), one-to-many (q-3/23), migrations (q-4/24), client+pooling (q-5/16/35/40), nested writes (q-6/26/31), select-vs-include (q-7/27), pagination (q-8/15/28/32), raw SQL (q-11/29), middleware (q-13/30), generators (q-17/36), multi-schema (q-18/38), Prisma-vs-TypeORM (q-19/37), N+1 (q-14/34/39). In each pair one answer is written properly (a real mechanism, version caveats, numbers) and the other is a 40-90-word restatement whose pitfall is a generic one-liner. Because nobody reconciled them, the pairs now teach different things: q-7 vs q-27 on whether include/select can nest, q-16 vs q-35 vs q-40 on where connection_limit lives, q-17 vs q-36 on whether `@prisma/internals` or `@prisma/generator-helper` is the generator API (q-36 explicitly names q-17's choice as the trap). Deduplicating is the single highest-value fix in this zone and it removes nothing: every thin answer's content is already inside its fuller twin.

Difficulty labels do not track depth. Five answers tagged `senior` (q-34, q-35, q-38, q-39, q-40) are 55-90 prose words and answerable by a junior, while the articles cover the same ground far deeper: q-34/q-39 give N+1 = 'use include or select', where ru/05 gives diagnosis via `log: ['query']` plus three graded solutions plus the Cartesian-product counter-warning; q-35/q-40 give pooling = 'use a singleton', where ru/05 gives `connection_limit`, `pool_timeout`, the serverless `connection_limit=1` rule and PgBouncer/Accelerate. The bank's low mechanical flag density is exactly this: those answers are too short to contain a long sentence.

Articles put a code or txt block under every new idea — and article 07 is the same content with the blocks removed. Files 01-06 score D 4-5 because the habit is rigorous: claim, then snippet with inline comments, then the next claim. File 07 (both locales) has one code block for 18 answers and a 35-paragraph run, and it is the only genuinely hard-to-read file in the zone. The repair is mechanical: 07's answers and 01-06's snippets are already about the same things.

Latin-script terms are used as running Russian words and never glossed once: «schema-first подход», «runtime-ошибка», «Nested Writes», «Referential Actions», «source of truth», «workaround», «locality», «page splits», «overhead», «inference», «seq scan», «eager loading». All six RU article H1s are untranslated English («# Prisma Fundamentals», «# Prisma Schema and Models», …), as are many section heads («## CI/CD pipeline с Prisma», «## Bulk операции»). This is the main driver of G = 2.9 in files that are otherwise written in living Russian.

The RU bank's thin tier is visibly unedited machine translation, and the tells are mechanical enough to grep: hyphen used as a dash (« - » in q-5, 7, 11, 13, 28, 33), em dash with no surrounding spaces carried over from English (10 RU / 12 EN answers), an English preposition left in place («per запрос», q-16), nominalised calques of English gerunds («Не ожидание `next(params)`», q-30), and a bare grammar error («Создание новый экземпляра», q-5). None of these appear in the ten well-written answers, so the fix is scoped to a known list.
